   286                                  ;; Macro: call a BASIC ROM routine
   287                          !macro caml_JSR_BASROM .routine {
   288                            !ifndef caml_basic_rom_overlap {              ;Best case: code never overlaps
   289                                  JSR .routine                            ;BASIC ROM
   290                            } else {
   291                              !if @x < C64_BASROM {                       ;BASROM is disabled but this
   292                                  JSR caml_BASROM_on                      ;part of code doesn't overlap it
   293                                  JSR .routine
   294                                  JSR caml_BASROM_off
   295                          @x  } else {                                    ;Worst case: this part of code
   296                                  PHP                                     ;overlaps BASIC ROM. Pass the
   297                                  PHA                                     ;routine address to a wrapper
   298                                  LDA # <.routine                         ;in a safe zone and call it
   299                                  STA caml_BASROM_addr
   300                                  LDA # >.routine
   301                                  STA caml_BASROM_addr + 1
   302                                  JSR caml_BASROM_wrapper
   303                              }
   304                            }
   305                          }

   308                          caml_BASROM_wrapper                             ;Wrapper for 'Worst case' above
   309                                  LDA C64_D6510
   310                                  ORA # %00000011
   311                                  STA C64_D6510
   312                                  PLA
   313                                  PLP
   314                          caml_BASROM_addr = * + 1
   315                                  JSR .dummy                              ;SMC: JSR .routine
   316                                  ;; fallthrough caml_BASROM_off
   317                          caml_BASROM_off                                 ;Deactivate BASIC ROM

   358  0a3d 8e570a                     STX @arg + 1                            ; save error no. using
   359  0a40 38                         SEC                                     ; the OCaml int representation
   360  0a41 2e560a                     ROL @arg
   361  0a44 2e570a                     ROL @arg + 1
   362  0a47 a954                       LDA # <@blk
   363  0a49 852c                       STA ACCU
   364  0a4b a90a                       LDA # >@blk
   365  0a4d 852d                       STA ACCU + 1                            ; ACCU := exn address
   366  0a4f 4c0b2c                     JMP RAISE                               ; raise Sys_error(error no.)
   367                                  !align $01, $00                         ;Exception block:
   368  0a52 0002                       !byte 0, 2                              ; Tag, Size
   369  0a54 a208               @blk    !word caml_std_exn[Sys_error]           ; Field0 = Sys_error exn
   370  0a56 3412               @arg    !word .dummy                            ; Field1 = Val_Int(error no.)
   371                          
   372                          ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   373                          ;;      ZEROPAGE BUFFER - ZP values are saved here at initializazion and
   374                          ;;      restored at end. If caml_INTERP=1, the buffer also contains the
   375                          ;;      fetch-exec routine to be copied into ZP by caml_init.
   376                          ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   377                          
   378                          caml_zp_buf
   379  0a58 0000000000000000...        !fill 11                                ;11 by. for ZAM2 registers
   380                          !ifdef  caml_INTERP {
   381                            !pseudopc caml_interp_fetch {
   382                                          @PC  = @fetch + 1               ;Bytecode interpreter
   383                                          @idx = @exec + 1                ;fetch-exec routine:
   384                          @fetch          LDA .dummy                      ; 3 by. SMC: fetch next opc
   385                                          INC+1 @PC                       ; 2 by. incr. LDA operand (PCl)
   386                                          BNE +                           ; 2 by.
   387                                          INC+1 @PC + 1                   ; 2 by. incr. LDA operand (PCh)
   388                          +
   389                              !ifdef caml_DEBUG {
   390                                          JSR caml_debug
   391                              } else {
   392                                          ASL                             ; 1 by. C:A = 2 * opc
   393                                          STA+1 @idx                      ; 2 by. modify JMP() operand
   394                              }
   395                          @exec           JMP (caml_interp_jmptbl)        ; 3 by. SMC: JMP(>jmptbl + A)
   396                            }                                             ;--
   397  0a63 0000000000000000...} else {!fill 15}                               ;15 by. total
   398  0a72 0000000000000000...        !fill 28                                ;28 by. for BLK, GC, TMP
   399                          
   400                          ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   401                          ;;      INTERPRETER TRACING DEBUGGER
   402                          ;;      | PC | Opcode | ACCU | SP[0] ... SP[5] | ENV | XARGS |
   403                          ;; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   404                          
   405                          !ifdef  caml_INTERP {
   406                          !ifdef caml_DEBUG {
   407                          caml_debug
   408                                  @RevOn  = $12
   409                                  @RevOff = $92
   410                                  @Cyan   = $9F
   411                                  @LBlue  = $9A
   412                                  @CR     = $0D
   413                                  PHP                                     ;       [S
   414                                  PHA                                     ;       [opc; S
   415                                  ;; print a header every 22 lines
   416                                  DEC @count
   417                                  BPL +
   418                                  LDA # @CR
   419                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   420                                  LDX # @hdr - @end                       ;negative number
   421                          -       LDA @end - $100,X
   422                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   423                                  INX
   424                                  BNE -
   425                                  LDA #21
   426                                  STA @count
   427                          +       ;; print PC
   428                                  LDA PC
   429                                  SEC
   430                                  SBC # 1
   431                                  PHA                                     ;       [PC; opc; S
   432                                  LDA PC + 1
   433                                  SBC # 0
   434                                  JSR @pr_hex
   435                                  PLA                                     ;A=PC   [opc; S
   436                                  JSR @pr_hex
   437                                  ;; print opcode
   438                                  LDA # @RevOn
   439                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   440                                  PLA                                     ;A=opc  [S
   441                                  PHA                                     ;       [opc; S
   442                                  JSR @pr_hex
   443                                  ;; print ACCU
   444                                  LDA # @Cyan
   445                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   446                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   447                                  JSR @pr_hex
   448                                  LDA ACCU
   449                                  JSR @pr_hex
   450                                  LDA # @RevOff
   451                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   452                                  ;; print top 6 stack elements
   453                                  LDY # 0
   454                          -       TYA
   455                                  PHA                                     ;       [Y/4; opc; S
   456                                  LSR
   457                                  LSR
   458                                  LDA # @LBlue
   459                                  BCS +                                   ;switch Cyan/LBlue
   460                                  LDA # @Cyan
   461                          +       JSR C64_CHROUT
   462                                  PLA                                     ;A=Y/4  [opc; S
   463                                  TAY
   464                                  LDA (SP),Y
   465                                  TAX
   466                                  INY
   467                                  LDA (SP),Y
   468                                  JSR @pr_hex                             ;print STACK[i]
   469                                  TXA
   470                                  JSR @pr_hex
   471                                  INY
   472                                  CPY # 12
   473                                  BNE -
   474                                  ;; print ENV
   475                                  LDA # @RevOn
   476                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   477                                  LDA ENV + 1
   478                                  JSR @pr_hex
   479                                  LDA ENV
   480                                  JSR @pr_hex
   481                                  ;; print XARGS
   482                                  LDA # @RevOff
   483                                  JSR C64_CHROUT
   484                                  LDA XARGS
   485                                  LSR
   486                                  JSR @pr_hex
   487                                  ;; continue fetch-exec
   488                                  PLA                                     ;A=opc  [S
   489                                  PLP                                     ;S      [
   490                                  ASL
   491                                  LDY # 0
   492                                  RTS
   493                          @count  !byte 0
   494                          @pr_hex PHA                                     ;       [A
   495                                  LSR
   496                                  LSR
   497                                  LSR
   498                                  LSR
   499                                  LDX # 2
   500                                  BNE +
   501                          -       PLA                                     ;A      [
   502                                  AND # $0F
   503                          +       CLC
   504                                  ADC # '0'
   505                                  CMP # '9' + 1
   506                                  BCC +
   507                                  ADC # 7 -1                              ;-1 as C=1
   508                          +       JSR C64_CHROUT
   509                                  DEX
   510                                  BNE -
   511                                  RTS
   512                          @hdr    !text @RevOn, "addr", @RevOff, "oc",   @Cyan,  "accu", @RevOn, "stk0"
   513                                  !text @LBlue, "   1", @Cyan,   "   2", @LBlue, "   3", @Cyan,  "   4"
   514                                  !text @LBlue, "   5", @RevOff, " env", @RevOn, "xa",   @RevOff
   515                          @end
   516                          }} ;ifdef caml_INTERP & caml_DEBUG
   517                          
   518                          caml_loader_end
   519                          } ;zone caml_LOADER

    24                          ;; Check for out-of-range argument
    25                          !macro caml_range .min, .arg, .max, .txt {
    26                            !if (.arg < .min) | (.arg > .max) {
    27                                  !error .txt + " = ", .arg, " out of range [", .min, ", ", .max, "]"
    28                            }
    29                          }

    44                          ;; i00-i12 depend on i08
    45                          !macro  i08 .n {                                ;ACCESS n
    46                                  +caml_range 0, .n, $7FFF, "ACC n: n" 
    47                                  .n2h = >(2 * .n)
    48                                  .n2l = <(2 * .n)
    49                            !if .n2l > 0 {
    50                                  LDY # .n2l
    51                            }
    52                            !if .n2h = 0 {
    53                                  !set    caml_gen_ACCL = 1
    54                                  JSR ACCL
    55                            } elif .n2h = 1 {
    56                                  !set    caml_gen_ACCL = 1
    57                                  INC SP + 1
    58                                  JSR ACCL
    59                                  DEC SP + 1
    60                            } else {
    61                                  !set    caml_gen_ACCH = 1
    62                                  LDA # .n2h
    63                                  JSR ACCH
    64                            }
    65                          }

    89                          !macro  i13 .n {                                ;POP n
    90                                  +caml_range 0, .n, $7FFF, "POP n: n"
    91                                  .n2h = >(2 * .n)
    92                                  .n2l = <(2 * .n)
    93                            !if .n = 0 {
    94                                  ;NOP
    95                            } elif .n = 1 {
    96                                  !set    caml_gen_POP1 = 1
    97                                  JSR POP1
    98                            } else {
    99                                  LDA # .n2l
   100                              !if .n2h > 0 {
   101                                  LDY # .n2h
   102                              }
   103                                  !set    caml_gen_POPN = 1
   104                                  JSR POPN
   105                            }
   106                          }
   107                          !macro  i14 .n {                                ;ASSIGN n
   108                                  +caml_range 0, .n, $7FFF, "ASSIGN n: n"
   109                                  .n2h = >(2 * .n)
   110                                  .n2l = <(2 * .n)
   111                                  !set    caml_gen_ASSIGNL = 1
   112                            !if .n2l > 0 {
   113                                  LDY # .n2l
   114                            }
   115                            !if .n2h = 0 {
   116                                  JSR ASSIGNL
   117                            } elif .n2h = 1 {
   118                                  INC SP + 1
   119                                  JSR ASSIGNL
   120                                  DEC SP + 1
   121                            } else {
   122                                  !set    caml_gen_ASSIGNH = 1
   123                                  LDA # .n2h
   124                                  JSR ASSIGNH
   125                                  STX SP + 1
   126                            }
   127                          }

   349                                  .n2h = >(2 * .n * Double_wosize)
   350                                  !set    caml_gen_GETFFLD0 = 1

   353                            }
   354                            !if .n2l > 0 {
   355                                  !set    caml_gen_GETFFLDN = 1
   356                                  LDA # .n2l
   357                                  JSR GETFFLDN
   358                            } else {
   359                                  JSR GETFFLD0
   360                            }
   361                          }

   436                          !macro  i57 .n, .tab {                          ;SWITCH n tab
   437                                  +caml_range 0, .n, $FF, "SWITCH n t: n"
   438                            !if (0 < .n) & (.n < len(.tab)) {             ;both iptrs & pptrs present,
   439                                  LDA ACCU                                ;select the appropriate
   440                                  AND # 1                                 ;jumptable section
   441                                  BEQ .pptrs
   442                            }
   443                            !if 0 < .n {
   444                                  !set    caml_gen_SWITCHI = 1            ;iptrs: pointers are stored in
   445                                  LDA # <(.adr - 1)                       ;ACCU = offset + 1,
   446                                  LDX # >(.adr - 1)                       ;so base address = .adr - 1
   447                                  JMP SWITCHI                             ;tab[0]...tab[n-1],
   448                            }
   449                          .pptrs
   450                            !if .n < len(.tab) {
   451                                  !set    caml_gen_SWITCHP = 1            ;pptrs: pointers are stored in
   452                                  LDA # <(.adr + 2 * .n)                  ;Tag(ACCU) = offset,
   453                                  LDX # >(.adr + 2 * .n)                  ;so base address = .adr + 2 * .n
   454                                  JMP SWITCHP                             ;tab[n]...tab[len-1],
   455                            }
   456                                  !align $01, $00                         ;avoid JMP($xxFF) bug
   457                          .adr    !word .tab                              ;jumptable
   458                          }

    18                          ;;	LDY # 0
    19                          ;;	STY ACCU + 1                            ;ACCUh := 0
    20                          ;;	JSR C64_GETIN				;A:=get char from keyboard queue
    21                          ;;	SEC
    22                          ;;	ROL

    24                          ;;	ROL ACCU + 1                            ;ACCUh := >Val_char(A)
    25                          ;;	RTS

    27                          IOtools_get_key
    28  27f7 462c               	LSR ACCU				;X := max retries (0-127)
    29  27f9 a62c               	LDX ACCU
    30  27fb 842d               	STY ACCU + 1                            ;ACCUh := 0
    31  27fd 203ef1             -       JSR C64_GETIN				;A:=get char from keyboard queue
    32  2800 d003               	BNE +
    33  2802 ca                 	DEX					;if null, retry (max X times)
    34  2803 d0f8               	BNE -
    35  2805 38                 +       SEC
    36  2806 2a                         ROL
    37  2807 852c                       STA ACCU                                ;ACCUl := <Val_char(A)
    38  2809 262d                       ROL ACCU + 1                            ;ACCUh := >Val_char(A)
    39  280b 60                         RTS

    41                          IOtools_videoram_read

    36                          !macro  caml_grow_stack .w {                    ;Increase stack by .w words,
    37                                  LDA SP                                  ;.w < 128.
    38                            !if .w = 1 {
    39                                  BNE +
    40                                  DEC SP + 1
    41                                  LDA SP + 1
    42                                  CMP # >caml_stack_start
    43                                  BCS +
    44                                  JMP caml_stack_overflow
    45                          +       DEC SP
    46                                  DEC SP
    47                            } else {

    52                                  DEC SP + 1

    54                                  CMP # >caml_stack_start

    66                          ;; see the comment at caml_init in loader.asm).

  2023                                          CLC
  2024                                          JMP OFSCLM2
  2025                          }
  2026                          
  2027                          OFSCLM2
  2028                          !ifdef caml_gen_OFSCLM2 {
  2029                                          LDA ENV
  2030                                          SBC # 4 -1                      ;-1 as C=0
  2031                                          STA ACCU
  2032                                          LDA ENV + 1
  2033                                          SBC # 0
  2034                                          STA ACCU + 1
  2035                                          +caml_NEXT
  2036                          }
  2037                          
  2038                          PHOFSCL0
  2039                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHOFSCL0 {
  2040                                          JSR PUSH
  2041                                          JMP OFSCL0
  2042                          }
  2043                          
  2044                          PHOFSCL2
  2045                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHOFSCL2 {
  2046                                          JSR PUSH
  2047                                          CLC
  2048                                          JMP OFSCL2
  2049                          }
  2050                          
  2051                          OFSCL2
  2052                          !ifdef caml_gen_OFSCL2 {
  2053                                          LDA ENV
  2054                                          ADC # 4                         ;C=0
  2055                                          STA ACCU
  2056                                          LDA ENV + 1
  2057                                          ADC # 0
  2058                                          STA ACCU + 1
  2059                                          +caml_NEXT
  2060                          }
  2061                          
  2062                          PHOFSCLN
  2063                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHOFSCLN {
  2064                                          JSR PUSH
  2065                                          JMP OFSCLN
  2066                          }
  2067                          
  2068                          PHGETGLB
  2069                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHGETGLB {

  2071                                          JMP GETGLB

  2075                          !ifdef caml_gen_GETGLB {
  2076                                          JSR GETGLBSUB
  2077                                          +caml_NEXT
  2078                          GETGLBSUB                                       ;called by [PH]GETGLB[FLD]
  2079                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2080                                          STA ACCU
  2081                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2082                                          STA ACCU + 1
  2083                                          CMP # >caml_glob_table          ;return if ACCU is an address
  2084                                          BCC +                           ; of a standard exception blk
  2085                                          INY                             ;else ACCU points to the global
  2086                                          LDA (ACCU),Y                    ; table: access it and get the
  2087                                          TAX                             ; value
  2088                                          DEY
  2089                                          LDA (ACCU),Y
  2090                                          STA ACCU
  2091                                          STX ACCU + 1
  2092                          +               RTS
  2093                          }
  2094                          
  2095                          PHGETGLBFLD
  2096                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHGETGLBFLD {
  2097                                          JSR PUSH
  2098                                          JMP GETGLBFLD
  2099                          }
  2100

  2102                          !ifdef caml_gen_GETGLBFLD {
  2103                                          JSR GETGLBSUB
  2104                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2105                                          ASL
  2106                                          BCC +
  2107                                          INC ACCU + 1
  2108                          +               TAY
  2109                                          LDA (ACCU),Y
  2110                                          TAX
  2111                                          INY
  2112                                          LDA (ACCU),Y
  2113                                          STX ACCU
  2114                                          STA ACCU + 1
  2115                                          LDY #0
  2116                                          +caml_NEXT
  2117                          }
  2118                          
  2119                          PHATOM0

  2122                                          JMP ATOM0

  2128                                          STA ACCU
  2129                                          LDA # >caml_atom0

  2131                                          +caml_NEXT
  2132                          }
  2133                          
  2134                          MKBLKN
  2135                          !ifdef caml_gen_MKBLKN {
  2136                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2137                                          TAX                             ;X = size
  2138                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg          ;A = tag
  2139                                          JMP MKBLK
  2140                          }
  2141                          
  2142                          MKBLK13
  2143                          !ifdef caml_gen_MKBLK13 {
  2144                                          SBC # $7C -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n=2*opc-$7C
  2145                                          LSR
  2146                                          TAX                             ;X = size
  2147                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg          ;A = tag
  2148                                          JMP MKBLK
  2149                          }
  2150                          
  2151                          GETFLD13
  2152                          !ifdef caml_gen_GETFLD13 {
  2153                                          SBC # $86 -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n=2*opc-$86
  2154                                          TAY
  2155                                          JMP GETFLD0
  2156                          }
  2157                          
  2158                          SETFLD13
  2159                          !ifdef caml_gen_SETFLD13 {
  2160                                          SBC # $93 -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n-1=2*opc-$93
  2161                                          ADC ACCU                        ;A:=2n-1+ACCU +1 as C=1
  2162                                          STA ACCU                        ;ACCU:=2n+ACCU
  2163                                          BCC SETFLD0
  2164                                          INC ACCU + 1
  2165                                          JMP SETFLD0
  2166                          }
  2167                          
  2168                          BIF
  2169                          !ifdef caml_gen_BIF {
  2170                                          LDA ACCU
  2171                                          LSR
  2172                                          ORA ACCU + 1
  2173                                          BEQ +
  2174                                          JMP BRANCH
  2175                          +               CLC:JMP caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2176                          }
  2177                          
  2178                          BIFNOT
  2179                          !ifdef caml_gen_BIFNOT {
  2180                                          LDA ACCU
  2181                                          LSR
  2182                                          ORA ACCU + 1
  2183                                          BNE +
  2184                                          JMP BRANCH
  2185                          +               CLC:JMP caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2186                          }
  2187                          
  2188                          SWITCH
  2189                          !ifdef caml_gen_SWITCH {
  2190                                          LDA (PC),Y                      ;A := n
  2191                                          STA TMP
  2192                                          BEQ @pptrs
  2193                                          LDA ACCU
  2194                                          AND # 1
  2195                                          BEQ @pptrs
  2196                                          LDA PC
  2197                                          LDX PC + 1
  2198                                          BNE SWITCHI                     ;BNE=JMP
  2199                          @pptrs          LDX PC + 1
  2200                                          ASL TMP
  2201                                          BCC +
  2202                                          INX
  2203                          +               LDA PC
  2204                                          SEC                             ;+1
  2205                                          ADC TMP
  2206                                          BCC +
  2207                                          INX
  2208                          +               JMP SWITCHP
  2209                          }
  2210                          
  2211                          PHCST03
  2212                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHCST03 {
  2213                                          SBC # $CF -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n+1=2*opc-$CF
  2214                                          TAX
  2215                                          JSR PUSH
  2216                                          STX ACCU                        ;ACCU:=Val_int(opcode-$CF)
  2217                                          STY ACCU + 1
  2218                                          +caml_NEXT
  2219                          }
  2220                          
  2221                          CST03
  2222                          !ifdef caml_gen_CST03 {
  2223                                          SBC # $C5 -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n+1=2*opc-$C5
  2224                                          STA ACCU                        ;ACCU:=Val_int(opcode-$63)
  2225                                          STY ACCU + 1
  2226                                          +caml_NEXT
  2227                          }
  2228                          
  2229                          PHCSTN
  2230                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHCSTN {
  2231                                          TAX
  2232                                          JSR PUSH
  2233                                          TXA
  2234                                          JMP CSTN
  2235                          }
  2236                          
  2237                          CSTN
  2238                          !ifdef caml_gen_CSTN {
  2239                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2240                                          STA ACCU
  2241                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2242                                          STA ACCU + 1
  2243                                          +caml_NEXT
  2244                          }
  2245                          
  2246                                  ;; "PAIRED OPCODES" DISAMBIGUATION.
  2247                                  ;; Two opcodes are paired iff their bits are equal but the msb.
  2248                                  ;; Paired opcodes share the same jumptable place (see at end);
  2249                                  ;; the fetch-exec routine sets C = msb of fetched opcode.
  2250                                  ;; N.b.: the routines placement guarantees that conditional
  2251                                  ;; branches targets stay in range [-128, +127]
  2252                          
  2253                          !set PUSH_ULTINT = *
  2254                          !ifdef caml_gen_PUSH_ULTINT {
  2255                            !ifdef caml_gen_PUSH {
  2256                              !ifdef caml_gen_ULTINT {
  2257                                          BCS +
  2258                                          JSR PUSH
  2259                                          +caml_NEXT
  2260                          +               JMP ULTINT
  2261                              } else {    JSR PUSH
  2262                                          +caml_NEXT }
  2263                            } else { !set PUSH_ULTINT = ULTINT }
  2264                          }
  2265                          
  2266                          PHACC5_STOP
  2267                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC5_STOP {
  2268                                          BCC PHACC17
  2269                                          JMP STOP
  2270                          }
  2271                          
  2272                          PHACC17
  2273                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC17 {
  2274                                          SBC # $14 -1                    ;-1 as C=0; A:=2n=2*opc-$14
  2275                                          STA TMP
  2276                                          JSR PUSH
  2277                                          LDY TMP                         ;Y:=2n
  2278                                          JMP ACCL
  2279                          }
  2280                          
  2281                          !set ACC_BGEINT = *
  2282                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC_BGEINT {
  2283                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACCH {
  2284                              !ifdef caml_gen_BGTGEINT {
  2285                                          BCS BGTGEINT
  2286                                          JMP ACCH
  2287                              } else { !set ACC_BGEINT = ACCH }
  2288                            } else { !set ACC_BGEINT = BGTGEINT }
  2289                          }
  2290                          
  2291                          !set ACC7_BGTINT = *
  2292                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC7_BGTINT {
  2293                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2294                              !ifdef caml_gen_BGTGEINT {
  2295                                          BCC ACC07
  2296                                          ;; fallthrough BGTGEINT
  2297                              } else { !set ACC7_BGTINT = ACC07 }
  2298                            } else { !set ACC7_BGTINT = BGTGEINT }
  2299                          }
  2300                          BGTGEINT
  2301                          !ifdef caml_gen_BGTGEINT {
  2302                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2303                                          TAX
  2304                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2305                                          TAY
  2306                                          TXA
  2307                                          JSR SGNCMP
  2308                                          BPL BRANCH                      ;OK: BPL +119
  2309                                          CLC:JMP caml_interp_skip2or3by  ;no BCC, it'll be out-of-range
  2310                          }
  2311                          
  2312                          !set PHACC1_BULTINT = *
  2313                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC1_BULTINT {
  2314                            !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC17 {
  2315                              !ifdef caml_gen_BULTINT {
  2316                                          BCC PHACC17
  2317                                          ;; fallthrough BULTINT
  2318                              } else { !set PHACC1_BULTINT = PHACC17 }
  2319                            } else { !set PHACC1_BULTINT = BULTINT }
  2320                          }
  2321                          BULTINT
  2322                          !ifdef caml_gen_BULTINT {
  2323                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2324                                          CMP ACCU
  2325                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2326                                          SBC ACCU + 1
  2327                                          BCC BRANCH
  2328                                          CLC:BCC caml_interp_skip2or3by  ;OK: BCC +116
  2329                          }
  2330                          
  2331                          !set PHACC2_BUGEINT = *
  2332                          !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC2_BUGEINT {
  2333                            !ifdef caml_gen_PHACC17 {
  2334                              !ifdef caml_gen_BUGEINT {
  2335                                          BCC PHACC17
  2336                                          ;; fallthrough BUGEINT 
  2337                              } else { !set PHACC2_BUGEINT = PHACC17 }
  2338                            } else { !set PHACC2_BUGEINT = BUGEINT }
  2339                          }
  2340                          BUGEINT
  2341                          !ifdef caml_gen_BUGEINT {
  2342                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2343                                          CMP ACCU
  2344                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2345                                          SBC ACCU + 1
  2346                                          BCS BRANCH
  2347                                          CLC:BCC caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2348                          }
  2349                          
  2350                          !set ACC0_OFSREF = *
  2351                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC0_OFSREF {

  2355                                          JMP OFSREF
  2356                              } else { !set ACC0_OFSREF = ACC07 }
  2357                            } else { !set ACC0_OFSREF = OFSREF }
  2358                          }
  2359                          
  2360                          !set ACC1_ISINT = *
  2361                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC1_ISINT {
  2362                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2363                              !ifdef caml_gen_ISINT {
  2364                                          BCC ACC07
  2365                                          JMP ISINT
  2366                              } else { !set ACC1_ISINT = ACC07 }
  2367                            } else { !set ACC1_ISINT = ISINT }
  2368                          }
  2369                          
  2370                          !set ACC3_BEQ = *
  2371                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC3_BEQ {
  2372                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2373                              !ifdef caml_gen_BEQ {
  2374                                          BCC ACC07
  2375                                          ;; fallthrough BEQ_
  2376                              } else { !set ACC3_BEQ = ACC07 }
  2377                            } else { !set ACC3_BEQ = BEQ_ }
  2378                          }
  2379                          BEQ_
  2380                          !ifdef caml_gen_BEQ {
  2381                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2382                                          CMP ACCU
  2383                                          BEQ +
  2384                                          SEC:BCS caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2385                          +               JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2386                                          CMP ACCU + 1
  2387                                          BEQ BRANCH
  2388                                          CLC:BCC caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2389                          }
  2390                          
  2391                          !set ACC4_BNEQ = *
  2392                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC4_BNEQ {

  2397                              } else { !set ACC4_BNEQ = ACC07 }
  2398                            } else { !set ACC4_BNEQ = BNEQ }
  2399                          }
  2400                          BNEQ
  2401                          !ifdef caml_gen_BNEQ {
  2402                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2403                                          CMP ACCU
  2404                                          BNE +
  2405                                          SEC:BCS caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2406                          +               JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2407                                          CMP ACCU + 1
  2408                                          BNE BRANCH
  2409                                          CLC:BCC caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2410                          }
  2411                          
  2412                          !set ACC5_BLTINT = *
  2413                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC5_BLTINT {
  2414                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2415                              !ifdef caml_gen_BLTLEINT {
  2416                                          BCS BLTLEINT
  2417                                          ;; fallthrough ACC07
  2418                              } else { !set ACC5_BLTINT = ACC07 }
  2419                            } else { !set ACC5_BLTINT = BLTLEINT }
  2420                          }
  2421                          ACC07
  2422                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2423                                          TAY                             ;Y=2n
  2424                                          JMP ACCL
  2425                          }
  2426                          
  2427                          !set ACC6_BLEINT = *
  2428                          !ifdef caml_gen_ACC6_BLEINT {
  2429                            !ifdef caml_gen_ACC07 {
  2430                              !ifdef caml_gen_BLTLEINT {
  2431                                          BCC ACC07
  2432                                          ;; fallthrough BLTLEINT
  2433                              } else { !set ACC6_BLEINT = ACC07 }
  2434                            } else { !set ACC6_BLEINT = BLTLEINT }
  2435                          }
  2436                          BLTLEINT
  2437                          !ifdef caml_gen_BLTLEINT {
  2438                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2439                                          TAX
  2440                                          JSR caml_interp_getarg
  2441                                          TAY
  2442                                          TXA
  2443                                          JSR SGNCMP
  2444                                          BMI BRANCH
  2445                                          CLC:BCC caml_interp_skip2or3by
  2446                          }
  2447                                          ;; BRANCH, START, FETCH ARG, SKIP ARG.
  2448                          
  2449                          BRANCH                                          ;Branch to *PC
  2450                                          LDA (PC),Y
  2451                                          TAX
  2452                                          INC PC
  2453                                          BNE +
  2454                                          INC PC + 1
  2455                          +               LDA (PC),Y
  2456                                          ;; fallthrough caml_interp_start
  2457                          caml_interp_start                               ;ENTRYPOINT: start interpreter
  2458                                          STX PC
  2459                                          STA PC + 1
  2460                                          JMP caml_interp_fetch
  2461                          
  2462                          caml_interp_skip2or3by                          ;Skip next 2 + Carry bytes
  2463                                          LDA # 2
  2464                                          ADC PC
  2465                                          STA PC
  2466                                          BCC +
  2467                                          INC PC + 1
  2468                          +               JMP caml_interp_fetch
  2469                          
  2470                          caml_interp_getarg                              ;Fetch a 1-byte argument
  2471                                          LDA (PC),Y
  2472                                          INC PC
  2473                                          BNE +
  2474                                          INC PC + 1
  2475                          +               RTS
  2476                          
  2477                                          ;; OPCODES JUMPTABLE.
  2478                                          ;; The table is page-aligned. The fetch-exec routine sets C=bit7
  2479                                          ;; of fetched opcode, then accesses the table using 2*opcode as
  2480                                          ;; an index.  
  2481                          
  2482                                          !align  $FF, $00
  2483                          caml_interp_jmptbl
  2484                                          ;; $00...$0f/$80...$8f  (unused opcodes: $0a, $82, $8d, $8e)
  2485                                          !wo ACC0_OFSREF, ACC1_ISINT, ACC07, ACC3_BEQ, ACC4_BNEQ
  2486                                          !wo ACC5_BLTINT, ACC6_BLEINT, ACC7_BGTINT, ACC_BGEINT
  2487                                          !wo PUSH_ULTINT, UGEINT, PHACC1_BULTINT, PHACC2_BUGEINT 
  2488                                          !wo PHACC17, PHACC17, PHACC5_STOP
  2489                                          ;; $10...$1f/$90...$94  (unused opcodes: $90...$94)
  2490                                          !wo PHACC17, PHACC17, PHACC, POPN, ASSIGNH, ENVACC14, ENVACC14
  2491                                          !wo ENVACC14, ENVACC14, ENVACCN, PHENVACC14, PHENVACC14
  2492                                          !wo PHENVACC14, PHENVACC14, PHENVACC, PHRET
  2493                                          ;; $20...$2f
  2494                                          !wo APPLYN, APPLY13, APPLY13, APPLY13, APPTRMN, APPTRM13
  2495                                          !wo APPTRM13, APPTRM13, RETURN, RESTART, GRAB, CLOSURE, CLOSREC
  2496                                          !wo OFSCLM2, OFSCL0, OFSCL2
  2497                                          ;; $30...$3f            (unused opcodes: $3b, $3d)
  2498                                          !wo OFSCLN, PHOFSCLM2, PHOFSCL0, PHOFSCL2, PHOFSCLN, GETGLB
  2499                                          !wo PHGETGLB, GETGLBFLD, PHGETGLBFLD, SETGLB, ATOM0, $ffff
  2500                                          !wo PHATOM0, $ffff, MKBLKN, MKBLK13
  2501                                          ;; $40...$4f
  2502                                          !wo MKBLK13, MKBLK13, MKFBLK, GETFLD0, GETFLD13, GETFLD13
  2503                                          !wo GETFLD13, GETFLDN, GETFFLDN, SETFLD0, SETFLD13, SETFLD13
  2504                                          !wo SETFLD13, SETFLDN, SETFFLDN, VECLEN
  2505                                          ;; $50...$5f            (unused opcode: $5c)
  2506                                          !wo GETVEC, SETVEC, GETCHR, SETCHR, BRANCH, BIF, BIFNOT, SWITCH
  2507                                          !wo BOOLNOT, PHTRP, POPTRP, RAISE, $ffff, CCALL, CCALL, CCALL
  2508                                          ;; $60...$6f
  2509                                          !wo CCALL, CCALL, CCALL, CST03, CST03, CST03, CST03, CSTN
  2510                                          !wo PHCST03, PHCST03, PHCST03, PHCST03, PHCSTN, NEGINT, ADDINT
  2511                                          !wo SUBINT
  2512                                          ;; $70...$7f
  2513                                          !wo MULINT, DIVINT, MODINT, ANDINT, ORINT, XORINT, LSLINT
  2514                                          !wo LSRINT, ASRINT, EQ, NEQ, LTINT, LEINT, GTINT, GEINT, OFSINT
  2515                          
  2516                          } ;ifdef caml_INTERP

    15                          ;;; ==========================================================================
    16                          ;;; MEMORY MANAGEMENT - HEAP ALLOCATION AND GARBAGE COLLECTION
    17                          ;;; ==========================================================================
    18                          
    19                          !zone caml_MEMORY {
    20                          caml_memory
    21                          
    22                          .dummy = $1234                          ;dummy operand for self-modifying
    23                                                                  ;code (SMC in comments)
    24                          
    25                                  ;; CONSTANTS
    26                          .heap_start     = caml_glob_data                ;start of heap
    27                          .heap_end       = caml_stack_start              ;end of heap + 1
    28                          .halfsz = ((.heap_end - .heap_start) div 4) * 2 ;heap half-size; ensure it's even
    29                          
    30                                  ;; VARIABLES
    31  2fd1 b435               .CUR_START      !word .heap_start               ;current half
    32  2fd3 da68               .CUR_END        !word .heap_start + .halfsz     ;end of current half
    33  2fd5 da68               .OTH_START      !word .heap_start + .halfsz     ;other half of the heap
    34  2fd7 009c               .OTH_END        !word .heap_start + .halfsz * 2 ;end of other half
    35                          
    37                          ;; globals - due strategie possibili:
    38                          ;; 1) considero i globals già allocati nello heap, con .heap_start =

   376                          caml_shrink_latest_alloc
   377                                  ;; Reduce the size of the latest allocated block; new size MUST BE less
   378                                  ;; than the original one (no check) and NO GARBAGE COLLECTION occurred
   379                                  ;; since the block allocation. Params: X=size>0, Y=0, BLK=address.
   380                                  ;; Shrinking is done by updating the new size in the block's header and
   381                                  ;; the HEAP pointer.
   382                                  ;; Return: A=X=size, Y=0.
   383                          @SZ     = GC                                    ;2 by - block size in bytes
   384  3216 c658                       DEC BLK + 1                             ;Prepare access to the 'size'
   385  3218 88                         DEY                                     ; byte in block's header
   386  3219 b157                       LDA (BLK),Y                             ;Read original size from header
   387  321b 8559                       STA @SZ                                 ; and save it
   388  321d 8a                         TXA                                     ;A := new size
   389  321e 9157                       STA (BLK),Y                             ;Write new size into header
   390  3220 e658                       INC BLK + 1                             ;Restore block pointer
   391  3222 c8                         INY                                     ; and Y register
   392  3223 49ff                       EOR # $FF                               ;Do an inverse subtraction:
   393  3225 38                         SEC                                     ; A := @SZ - A
   394  3226 6559                       ADC @SZ                                 ;    = orig.size - new size
   395  3228 0a                         ASL                                     ;Compute 2 * A
   396  3229 8559                       STA @SZ                                 ;Store result, lo byte, in @SZ
   397  322b 845a                       STY @SZ + 1                             ;Set @SZ + 1 to 0
   398  322d 265a                       ROL @SZ + 1                             ;Store result, MSB, in @SZ + 1
   399  322f a530                       LDA HEAP                                ;Recover unused block bytes by
   400  3231 38                         SEC                                     ; decrementing the heap pointer
   401  3232 e559                       SBC @SZ                                 ; by 2 * (orig.size - new size)
   402  3234 8530                       STA HEAP                                ;Store new value, lo byte
   403  3236 a531                       LDA HEAP + 1
   404  3238 e55a                       SBC @SZ + 1
   405  323a 8531                       STA HEAP + 1                            ;Store new value, hi byte
   406  323c 60                         RTS                                     ;Return.

    16                          ;;; ARRAYS (ocaml-4.04.1/byterun/array.c)
