   289                          caml_compare
   290                                  INY                                     ;set .COMPARE=1
   291                                  JSR caml_compare_val
   292                                  ;; FALLTHROUGH caml_compare_set_result
   293                          }
   294                          
   295                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_set_result {
   296                          caml_compare_set_result
   297                                  BPL +
   298                                  LDA # -1
   299                                  STA ACCU
   300                                  STA ACCU + 1
   301                                  RTS
   302                          +       SEC
   303                                  ROL
   304                                  STA ACCU
   305                                  STY ACCU + 1
   306                                  RTS
   307                          }
   308                          
   309                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_identity_setV2 {
   310                          caml_compare_identity_setV2
   311                                  ;; check if ACCU == SP[0] (physical identity)
   312                                  ;; yes: return Z = 1
   313                                  ;; no:  return Z = 0, .V2 = SP[0]
   314                                  LDA (SP),Y
   315                                  TAX
   316                                  INY
   317                                  LDA (SP),Y
   318                                  DEY
   319                                  CPX .V1
   320                                  BNE +
   321                                  CMP .V1 + 1
   322                                  BNE +
   323                                  RTS
   324                          +       STX .V2
   325                                  STA .V2 + 1
   326                                  RTS
   327                          }
   328                          
   329                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val {
   330                          caml_compare_val
   331                                  ;; Compare values in ACCU and SP[0].
   332                                  ;; PREREQUISITE: Y <> 0 if called by caml_compare, Y = 0 otherwise.
   333                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   334                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   335                                  STY .COMPARE                            ;Y <> 0 iif called by caml_compare
   336                                  LDY # 0
   337                                  LDA SP
   338                                  STA .SAVESP
   339                                  LDA SP + 1
   340                                  STA .SAVESP + 1
   341                                  LDA (SP),Y
   342                                  STA .V2
   343                                  INY
   344                                  LDA (SP),Y
   345                                  STA .V2 + 1
   346                          .loop   LDY # 0
   347                                  STY .CMP
   348                                  LDA .V1 + 1
   349                                  LDX .V1
   350                                  CPX .V2
   351                                  BEQ .eq_tst
   352                                  SBC .V2 + 1
   353                          .neq    BVC +                                   ;(signed) v1<v2 iif V xor N = 1
   354                                  ORA # $80
   355                          +       BMI +
   356                                  INC .CMP                                ;v1 > v2 => CMP := 1
   357                                  BNE .int_or_block                       ;bne=jmp
   358                          +       DEC .CMP                                ;v1 < v2 => CMP := -1
   359                                  BNE .int_or_block                       ;bne=jmp
   360                          .eq_tst SBC .V2 + 1
   361                                  BNE .neq
   362                                  CMP .COMPARE                            ;v1==v2; called by caml_compare?
   363                                  BEQ .int_or_block                       ;no: go deep, maybe raise exn :(
   364                                  JMP .next_item                          ;yes: speed up, go to next_item
   365                          .int_or_block
   366                                  TXA
   367                                  BIT caml_is_block
   368                                  BEQ .v1_block
   369                                  LDA .V2
   370                                  BIT caml_is_block
   371                                  BEQ .v1_int_v2_block
   372                                  LDA .CMP
   373                                  JMP .return_or_next
   374                          .v1_int_v2_block
   375                                  LDY # -2
   376                                  DEC .V2 + 1
   377                                  LDA (.V2),Y                             ;A := Tag(v2)
   378                                  INC .V2 + 1
   379                                  CMP # Forward_tag                       ;check for special cases
   380                                  BEQ .v2_forward
   381                                  CMP # Custom_tag
   382                                  BEQ .v2_custom
   383                                  LDA # -1
   384                                  JMP .return                             ;int < block => RETURN LESS
   385                          .v2_forward
   386                                  LDY # 1
   387                                  LDA (.V2),Y                             ;v2 := Field(v2,0)
   388                                  TAX
   389                                  DEY
   390                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   391                                  STX .V2 + 1
   392                                  STA .V2
   393                                  JMP .loop                               ;continue
   394                          .v2_custom
   395                                  LDY # 1
   396                                  LDA (.V2),Y                             ;load jmptbl address
   397                                  STA .v2jsr + 2
   398                                  DEY
   399                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   400                                  STA .v2jsr + 1
   401                          .v2jsr  JSR .dummy                              ;call custom_compare, res. in A
   402                                  JMP .return_or_next
   403                          .v1_block
   404                                  LDA .V2
   405                                  BIT caml_is_block
   406                                  BEQ .v1_block_v2_block
   407                                  LDY # -2                                ;v1:block, v2:int
   408                                  DEC .V1 + 1
   409                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;A := Tag(v1)
   410                                  INC .V1 + 1
   411                                  CMP # Forward_tag                       ;check for special cases
   412                                  BEQ .v1_forward
   413                                  CMP # Custom_tag
   414                                  BEQ .v1_cust_tst
   415                                  LDA # 1
   416                                  JMP .return                             ;block > int => RETURN GREATER
   417                          .v1_forward
   418                                  LDY # 1
   419                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;v1 := Field(v1,0)
   420                                  TAX
   421                                  DEY
   422                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   423                                  STX .V1 + 1
   424                                  STA .V1
   425                                  JMP .loop                               ;continue
   426                          .v1_cust_tst
   427                                  LDY # 1
   428                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;load jmptbl address
   429                                  STA .v1jsr + 2
   430                                  DEY
   431                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   432                                  STA .v1jsr + 1
   433                          .v1jsr  JSR .dummy                              ;call custom_compare, res. in A
   434                                  JMP .return_or_next
   435                          .v1_block_v2_block
   436                                  LDY # -2
   437                                  DEC .V1 + 1
   438                                  DEC .V2 + 1
   439                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   440                                  TAX                                     ;X := Tag_v2
   441                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;A := Tag_v1
   442                                  INC .V1 + 1
   443                                  INC .V2 + 1
   444                                  CMP # Forward_tag
   445                                  BEQ .v1_forward                         ;jump if Tag_v1=Forward_tag
   446                                  CPX # Forward_tag
   447                                  +beq .v2_forward                        ;jump if Tag_v2=Forward_tag
   448                                  STX .CMP
   449                                  SEC
   450                                  SBC .CMP
   451                                  BEQ .switch_on_tag                      ;Tag_v1=Tag_v2 =>choose routine
   452                                  JMP .return                             ;Tag_v1!=Tag_v2=>RETURN
   453                          .switch_on_tag
   454                                  CPX # String_tag                        ;dichotomic switch
   455                                  BCC .t249
   456                                  BNE .t254
   457                                  JSR caml_compare_val_string_tag
   458                                  JMP .return_or_next
   459                          .t249   CPX # Infix_tag
   460                                  BCC .t247
   461                                  BNE +
   462                          -       +caml_raise Invalid_argument, "compare: functional value"
   463                          +       +caml_raise Invalid_argument, "compare: abstract value"
   464                          .t247   CPX # Closure_tag
   465                                  BCC .default
   466                                  BEQ -
   467                                  JSR caml_compare_val_object_tag
   468                                  JMP .return_or_next
   469                          .t254   CPX # Double_array_tag
   470                                  BCC .t253
   471                                  BNE .t255
   472                                  JSR caml_compare_val_double_array_tag
   473                                  JMP .return_or_next
   474                          .t253   JSR caml_compare_val_double_tag
   475                                  JMP .return_or_next
   476                          .t255   JSR caml_compare_val_custom_tag
   477                                  JMP .return_or_next
   478                          .default
   479                                  ;; compare sizes first
   480                                  LDY # -1
   481                                  DEC .V1 + 1
   482                                  DEC .V2 + 1
   483                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;A := size(v1)
   484                                  TAX                                     ;save it
   485                                  SEC
   486                                  SBC (.V2),Y                             ;A := size(v1) - size(v2)
   487                                  BNE .return                             ;A <> 0 ==> return(A)
   488                                  TXA                                     ;reload size(v1)
   489                                  BEQ .next_item                          ;v1, v2 atoms ==> next_item
   490                                  INC .V1 + 1
   491                                  INC .V2 + 1
   492                                  DEX                                     ;only one field?
   493                                  BEQ .field0                             ;yes:compare Fld(v1,0) Fld(v2,0)
   494                                  +caml_grow_stack 3                      ;no: save data on stack:
   495                                  LDY # 0
   496                                  CLC
   497                                  LDA .V1
   498                                  ADC # 2
   499                                  STA (SP),Y
   500                                  INY
   501                                  LDA .V1 + 1
   502                                  ADC # 0
   503                                  STA (SP),Y                              ;address of Field(v1,1) in SP[0]
   504                                  INY
   505                                  CLC
   506                                  LDA .V2
   507                                  ADC # 2
   508                                  STA (SP),Y
   509                                  INY
   510                                  LDA .V2 + 1
   511                                  ADC # 0
   512                                  STA (SP),Y                              ;address of Field(v2,1) in SP[1]
   513                                  INY
   514                                  DEX                                     ;# of following fields in SP[2]
   515                                  TXA
   516                                  STA (SP),Y
   517                          .field0 LDY # 0
   518                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;get <Field(v1,0)
   519                                  TAX                                     ;save it
   520                                  LDA (.V2),Y                             ;get <Field(v2,0)
   521                                  STA .CMP                                ;save it
   522                                  INY
   523                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;get >Field(v1,0)
   524                                  STA .V1 + 1                             ;.V1 + 1 :=  >Field(v1,0)
   525                                  LDA (.V2),Y                             ;get >Field(v2,0)
   526                                  STA .V2 + 1                             ;.V2 + 1  := >Field(v2,0)
   527                                  STX .V1                                 ;.V1 := Field(v1,0)
   528                                  LDA .CMP
   529                                  STA .V2                                 ;.V2 := Field(v2,0)
   530                                  JMP .loop                               ;continue comparison on v1, v2
   531                          .return_or_next
   532                                  ORA # 0                                 ;set status byte according to A
   533                                  BEQ .next_item                          ;if A=0 then compare nexts
   534                          .return LDX .SAVESP                             ;else
   535                                  STX SP                                  ; restore SP
   536                                  LDX .SAVESP + 1
   537                                  STX SP + 1
   538                                  LDY # 0
   539                                  ORA # 0                                 ; set status byte according to A
   540                                  RTS                                     ; exit
   541                          .next_item
   542                                  LDA SP                                  ;if SP = .SAVESP
   543                                  CMP .SAVESP
   544                                  BNE +
   545                                  LDA SP + 1
   546                                  CMP .SAVESP + 1
   547                                  BNE +
   548                                  LDA # 0                                 ;then RETURN EQUAL
   549                                  BEQ .return                             ;BEQ=JMP
   550                          +       LDY # 0                                 ;else get next item from stack:
   551                                  LDA (SP),Y                              ;V1 := SP[0] (lo byte)
   552                                  STA .V1
   553                                  CLC
   554                                  ADC # 2
   555                                  STA (SP),Y                              ;SP[0] := &next field (lo byte)
   556                                  INY
   557                                  LDA (SP),Y                              ;as above, hi byte
   558                                  STA .V1 + 1
   559                                  ADC # 0
   560                                  STA (SP),Y
   561                                  INY
   562                                  LDA (SP),Y                              ;V2 := SP[1] (lo byte)
   563                                  STA .V2
   564                                  CLC
   565                                  ADC # 2
   566                                  STA (SP),Y                              ;SP[1] := &next field (lo byte)
   567                                  INY
   568                                  LDA (SP),Y                              ;as above, hi byte
   569                                  STA .V2 + 1
   570                                  ADC # 0
   571                                  STA (SP),Y
   572                                  INY
   573                                  LDA (SP),Y                              ;get counter of remaining fields
   574                                  BEQ +                                   ;if counter = 0, continue loop
   575                                  SEC
   576                                  SBC # 1                                 ;else decrement the counter
   577                                  STA (SP),Y
   578                                  CLC
   579                                  LDA # 6
   580                                  ADC SP
   581                                  STA SP
   582                                  BCC +
   583                                  INC SP + 1                              ;and pop items from stack
   584                          +       LDY # 1                                 ;get curr. Fld(v1,x), Fld(v2,x)
   585                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   586                                  TAX
   587                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   588                                  STA .CMP
   589                                  DEY
   590                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   591                                  STA .V1
   592                                  STX .V1 + 1
   593                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   594                                  STA .V2
   595                                  LDA .CMP
   596                                  STA .V2 + 1
   597                                  JMP .loop                               ;continue loop
   598                          }
   599                          
   600                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val_double_tag {
   601                          caml_compare_val_double_tag
   602                                  ;; Compare floats in ACCU and SP[0].
   603                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   604                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   605                                  LDA .V1
   606                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr
   607                                  LDA .V1 + 1
   608                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr + 1
   609                                  JSR caml_float_loadFAC
   610                                  LDY .V2 + 1
   611                                  LDA .V2
   612                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FCOMP
   613                                  LDY # 0
   614                                  ORA # 0                                 ;set status byte according to A
   615                                  RTS
   616                          }
   617                          
   618                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val_string_tag {
   619                          caml_compare_val_string_tag
   620                                  ;; Compare strings in ACCU and SP[0].
   621                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   622                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   623                                  LDY # -1
   624                                  DEC .V1 + 1
   625                                  DEC .V2 + 1
   626                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   627                                  TAX
   628                                  SEC
   629                                  SBC (.V2),Y
   630                                  STA .CMP                                ;CMP = size(v1) - size(v2)
   631                                  BCC +
   632                                  LDA (.V2),Y
   633                                  TAX                                     ;X := min(size(v1), size(v2))
   634                          +       INY                                     ;Y := 0
   635                          --      INC .V1 + 1                             ;for Y := 0 to X - 1 {
   636                                  INC .V2 + 1                             ;  compare char by char:
   637                          -       DEX
   638                                  BEQ ++
   639                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;  1st byte
   640                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   641                                  BCC @lt
   642                                  BNE @gt
   643                                  INY
   644                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;  2nd byte
   645                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   646                                  BCC @lt
   647                                  BNE @gt
   648                                  INY
   649                                  BNE -
   650                                  BEQ --                                  ;}
   651                          ++      LDA (.V1),Y                             ;last word, 1st char
   652                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   653                                  BCC @lt
   654                                  BNE @gt
   655                                                                          ;(sub)strings are =, return CMP
   656                                  LDA .CMP                                ;CMP is size(v1)-size(v2),
   657                                  BNE +                                   ;if CMP = 0, adjust result
   658                                  INY                                     ;according to string paddings:
   659                                  CLC                                     ;len_v1-len_v2=-pad_v1+pad_v2
   660                                  ADC (.V2),Y
   661                                  SEC
   662                                  SBC (.V1),Y
   663                          +       LDY # 0
   664                                  ORA # 0                                 ;set status byte according to A
   665                                  RTS
   666                          @lt     LDY # 0
   667                                  LDA # -1
   668                                  RTS
   669                          @gt     LDY # 0
   670                                  LDA # 1
   671                                  RTS
   672                          }
   673                          
   674                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val_custom_tag {
   675                          caml_compare_val_custom_tag
   676                                  ;; Compare custom values in ACCU and SP[0].
   677                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   678                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   679                                  +caml_raise Not_found
   680                          }
   681                          
   682                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val_double_array_tag {
   683                          caml_compare_val_double_array_tag
   684                                  ;; Compare floatarrays in ACCU and SP[0].
   685                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   686                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   687                                  +caml_raise Not_found
   688                          }
   689                          
   690                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_compare_val_object_tag {
   691                          caml_compare_val_object_tag
   692                                  ;; Compare objects in ACCU and SP[0].
   693                                  ;; Result: A </=/> 0 according to the OCaml semantics of compare.
   694                                  ;; Status byte is set according to A.
   695                                  +caml_raise Not_found
   696                          }
   697                          
   698                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_string_eq_neq {           ;caml_compare_val_string_tag is
   699                          caml_string_eq_neq                              ; slower for equality tests
   700                                  LDY # -1
   701                                  DEC .V1 + 1
   702                                  DEC .V2 + 1
   703                                  LDA (.V1),Y
   704                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   705                                  BNE @neq
   706                                  TAX
   707                                  INY                                     ;Y := 0
   708                          --      INC .V1 + 1                             ;loop:
   709                                  INC .V2 + 1                             ; compare strings chr by chr
   710                          -       DEX
   711                                  BEQ +
   712                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;1st byte
   713                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   714                                  BNE @neq
   715                                  INY
   716                                  LDA (.V1),Y                             ;2nd byte
   717                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   718                                  BNE @neq
   719                                  INY
   720                                  BEQ --
   721                                  BNE -
   722                          +       LDA (.V1),Y                             ;last word, 1st char
   723                                  CMP (.V2),Y
   724                                  BNE @neq
   725                                  LDY # 0
   726                                  TYA
   727                                  RTS
   728                          @neq    LDY # 0
   729                                  LDA # -1
   730                                  RTS
   731                          }
   732                          
   733                          }       ;; !zone caml_COMPARISONS

    19                          !zone caml_DUMMY {
    20                          
    21                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_alloc_dummy {
    22                                  ;; allocate a dummy block for a recursive value (or function)
    23                                  ;; ACCU = size, (SP[0] = function arity, ignored)
    24                          caml_alloc_dummy
    25                          caml_alloc_dummy_function
    26                                  LSR ACCU + 1
    27                                  LDA ACCU
    28                                  ROR
    29                                  BEQ +                           ; size = 0
    30                                  ;; allocate block
    31                                  TAX
    32                                  TYA
    33                                  JSR caml_alloc
    34                                  LDA BLK
    35                                  STA ACCU
    36                                  LDA BLK + 1
    37                                  STA ACCU + 1
    38                                  RTS
    39                                  ;; Atom(0)
    40                          +       LDA # < caml_atom0
    41                                  STA ACCU
    42                                  LDA # > caml_atom0
    43                                  STA ACCU + 1
    44                                  RTS
    45                          }
    46                          
    47                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_alloc_dummy_float {
    48                                  ;; allocate a dummy block for a recursive array/record of floats
    49                                  ;; ACCU = no. of floats
    50                          caml_alloc_dummy_float
    51                                  ;; ignore ACCU + 1, as 0 <= no. of floats <= 85
    52                                  LDA ACCU
    53                                  LSR
    54                                  BEQ +                           ; Atom(0)
    55                                  ;; X <- no. of floats * Double_wosize
    56                                  CLC
    57                                  ADC ACCU
    58                                  TAX
    59                                  DEX
    60                                  ;; allocate block
    61                                  TYA                             ; A = Y = 0
    62                                  JSR caml_alloc
    63                                  LDA BLK
    64                                  STA ACCU
    65                                  LDA BLK + 1
    66                                  STA ACCU + 1
    67                                  RTS
    68                                  ;; Atom(0)
    69                          +       LDA # < caml_atom0
    70                                  STA ACCU
    71                                  LDA # > caml_atom0
    72                                  STA ACCU + 1
    73                                  RTS
    74                          }
    75                          
    76                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_update_dummy {
    77                                  ;; update a dummy block with given value
    78                                  ;; ACCU = dummy, SP[0] = newval
    79                          caml_update_dummy
    80                                  ;; load newval size
    81                                  LDA (SP),Y
    82                                  STA TMP
    83                                  INY
    84                                  LDA (SP),Y
    85                                  STA TMP + 1
    86                                  LDY # -1
    87                                  DEC TMP + 1
    88                                  LDA (TMP),y
    89                                  BNE +
    90                                  ;; size = 0, update nothing
    91                                  INY                             ; Y = 0
    92                                  BEQ ++
    93                                  ;; tag(dummy) <- tag(newval)
    94                          +       TAX                             ; save size
    95                                  DEY
    96                                  DEC ACCU + 1
    97                                  LDA (TMP),y
    98                                  STA (ACCU),y
    99                                  INC ACCU + 1
   100                                  INC TMP + 1
   101                                  ;; copy newval fields into dummy ones
   102                                  TXA                             ; reload size
   103                                  ASL
   104                                  TAY                             ; Y = 2 * size, Carry = MSB
   105                                  JSR caml_blkcpy
   106                                  ;; ACCU <- ()
   107                          ++      STY ACCU + 1                    ; Y = 0
   108                                  LDA # <Val_unit
   109                                  STA ACCU
   110                                  RTS
   111                          }
   112                          
   113                          }       ;; !zone caml_DUMMY

    18                          
    19                          ;;; ZEROPAGE LOCATIONS
    20                          ;;; used by the C64's BASIC ROM floating point routines:
    21                          ;;;
    22                          ;;; $12         used by tan and (in preparation for tan) by sin & cos routines
    23                          ;;; $22-$23     used to move variables into the accumulators and back to memory
    24                          ;;; $24-$25     used during FP comparisons and when converting PETSCII into FP
    25                          ;;; $26-$2A     result of multiplication or division
    26                          ;;; $47         used by FOUT
    27                          ;;; $56         used in addition and subtraction, and also the exp function
    28                          ;;; $5C-$60     used by the PETSCII conversion routines
    29                          ;;; $61         FAC1 exponent
    30                          ;;; $62-$65     FAC1 mantissa
    31                          ;;; $66         FAC1 sign in bit 7
    32                          ;;; $67         used by trig, exp, log functions and PETSCII to FP conversion
    33                          ;;; $68         used during normalisation and FP to integer conversion
    34                          ;;; $69         FAC2 exponent
    35                          ;;; $6A-$6D     FAC2 mantissa
    36                          ;;; $6E         FAC2 sign in bit 7
    37                          ;;; $6F         sign result of arithmetic operations, set when FAC2 is loaded
    38                          ;;; $70         low order rounding byte for FAC1, cleared when FAC1 is loaded
    39                          ;;; $71-$72     used during series eval. and when converting PETSCII into FP
    40                          ;;; $73-$8A     CHRGET routine, used when converting a PETSCII string into FP
    41                          
    42                          !zone caml_FLOATS {
    43                          
    44                          .dummy  = $1234                                 ;dummy operand for self-modifying
    45                                                                          ;code (SMC in comments)
    46                          
    47                          !ifndef caml_float_zp_check {
    48                          caml_float_zp_check
    49                            !for .i in [[$12,$12],[$22,$2A],[$47,$47],[$56,$56],[$5C,$8A]] {
    50                              !if (caml_zp_start <= .i[1]) & (.i[0] < caml_zp_end) {
    51                                !warn "ZP storage overlaps FLPT workspace", .i
    52                              }
    53                            }
    54                          }
    55                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_nonstd_sign_float {
    56                          caml_nonstd_sign_float
    57                                  ;; Stdlib.sign_float
    58                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                            ;Read byte #0 (exponent)
    59                                  BEQ @zero                               ;Exponent=0 <=> float=0.
    60                                  INY
    61                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                            ;Read byte #1 (mantissa, msb)
    62                                  BPL @pos                                ;If the mantissa is negative,
    63                                  LDY # $FF                               ; set ACCU=Val_Int(-1)
    64                                  STY ACCU + 1
    65                                  STY ACCU
    66                                  INY
    67                                  RTS
    68                          @pos    DEY                                     ;else
    69                                  LDA # Val_one                           ; set ACCU=Val_Int(1)
    70                                  BNE @store                              ; BNE=JMP.
    71                          @zero   LDA # Val_zero                          ;Zero: set ACCU=Val_Int(0).
    72                          @store  STA ACCU
    73                                  STY ACCU + 1
    74                                  RTS                                     ;Y=0 at exit.
    75                          }

   231                          
   232                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_ceil_float {
   233                          caml_ceil_float
   234                                  ;; let fl = floor x in if fl = x then fl else fl +. 1.
   235                                  LDA ACCU
   236                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr
   237                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   238                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr + 1
   239                                  JSR caml_float_loadFAC
   240                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_INT
   241                                  LDA # ACCU
   242                                  LDY # ACCU + 1
   243                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FCOMP
   244                                  BEQ +
   245                                  LDA # <C64_ONE
   246                                  LDY # >C64_ONE
   247                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FADD
   248                          +       JMP caml_float_alloc_result
   249                          }
   250                          
   251                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_classify_float {
   252                          caml_classify_float
   253                                  +Val_Int ~@FP_normal, 0
   254                                  +Val_Int ~@FP_subnormal, 1
   255                                  +Val_Int ~@FP_zero, 2
   256                                  +Val_Int ~@FP_infinite, 3
   257                                  +Val_Int ~@FP_nan, 4
   258                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
   259                                  STY ACCU + 1            ;.Y = 0
   260                                  BEQ +
   261                                  LDA # @FP_normal
   262                                  STA ACCU
   263                                  RTS
   264                          +       LDA # @FP_zero
   265                                  STA ACCU
   266                                  RTS
   267                          }

   269                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_int_of_float {

   271                                  LDA ACCU

   273                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   274                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr + 1
   275                                  JSR caml_float_loadFAC
   276                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FACINX             ; result in Y(lo), A(hi)
   277                                  STY ACCU
   278                                  SEC
   279                                  ROL ACCU                        ; OCaml int repr
   280                                  ROL
   281                                  STA ACCU + 1
   282                                  LDY # 0
   283                                  RTS
   284                          }

   286                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_float_of_int {
   287                          caml_float_of_int
   288                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   289                                  CMP # $80                               ;CMP + ROR = arithm. shift right
   290                                  ROR
   291                                  TAX
   292                                  ROR ACCU
   293                                  LDY ACCU
   294                                  TXA
   295                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_GIVAYF
   296                                  JMP caml_float_alloc_result
   297                          }
   298

   300                          caml_copysign_float

   303                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   304                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr + 1

   312                                  STA C64_FAC + 5                 ;copy it to FAC sign byte
   313                                  JMP caml_float_alloc_result
   314                          }

   317                          caml_float_of_string
   318                                  LDA C64_CHRPTR
   319                                  STA TMP
   320                                  LDA C64_CHRPTR + 1
   321                                  STA TMP + 1
   322                                  LDA ACCU
   323                                  STA C64_CHRPTR
   324                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   325                                  STA C64_CHRPTR + 1
   326                                  JSR C64_CHRGOT                  ;not a BASIC ROM routine
   327                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FIN
   328                                  LDA TMP
   329                                  STA C64_CHRPTR
   330                                  LDA TMP + 1
   331                                  STA C64_CHRPTR
   332                                  JMP caml_float_alloc_result
   333                          }
   334                          
   335                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_ldexp_float {
   336                                  ;; compute ACCU * 2 ^ N, -255 < N < 255.
   337                                  ;; To be called with    SP[0] = Val_int(N) if N >= 0
   338                                  ;;                      SP[0] = Val_int(256-N) if N < 0
   339                          caml_ldexp_float
   340                                  LDA # Double_tag
   341                                  LDX # Double_wosize
   342                                  JSR caml_alloc
   343                                  INY
   344                                  LDA (SP),Y
   345                                  DEY
   346                                  LSR                             ;.A := Int_val(>SP[0])
   347                                  BEQ @add                        ;N >= 0 ?
   348                                  LDA (SP),Y                      ;no:
   349                                  ROR                             ;   .A := Int_val(SP[0])
   350                                  SEC
   351                                  EOR # $FF                       ;   subtract .A from exponent
   352                                  ADC (ACCU),Y                    ;   (eor/adc = inverse sbc)
   353                                  BCS @save                       ;   if underflow,
   354                                  LDA # 0                         ;   set exp = 0 (result = 0.0)
   355                          @save   STA (BLK),Y                     ;save exp byte
   356                                  BEQ +                           ;skip copy of mantissa if underflow
   357                                  LDY # 4
   358                          -       LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;copy mantissa
   359                                  STA (BLK),Y
   360                                  DEY
   361                                  BNE -
   362                          +       LDA BLK
   363                                  STA ACCU
   364                                  LDA BLK + 1
   365                                  STA ACCU + 1                    ;ACCU := BLK
   366                                  RTS
   367                          @add    LDA (SP),Y                      ;yes:
   368                                  ROR                             ;   .A := Int_val(SP[0])
   369                                  CLC
   370                                  ADC (ACCU),Y                    ;   add .A to exponent
   371                                  BCC @save                       ;   go to @save
   372                                  LDX # C64_ERR_OVERFLOW          ;   manage overflow (error)
   373                                  JMP (C64_IERROR)
   374                          }
   375                          
   376                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_frexp_float {
   377                          caml_frexp_float
   378                                  @NEW = BLK                      ;used by caml_alloc
   379                                  @FLO = TMP
   380                                  ;; allocate a new float with same mantissa and exp=0
   381                                  LDA # Double_tag                ;tag of new float
   382                                  LDX # Double_wosize             ;size of new float
   383                                  JSR caml_alloc                  ;alloc new float
   384                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;load (biased) exponent
   385                                  PHA                             ;save it for later
   386                                  BNE @nz                         ;float is 0.0?
   387                                  STA (@NEW),Y                    ;yes: set new float exp = 0
   388                                  BEQ @pair                       ;     and go further
   389                          @nz     LDA # $80                       ;no: set new float exp = $80
   390                                  STA (@NEW),Y
   391                                  LDY # 4                         ;    then copy the mantissa
   392                          -       LDA (ACCU),Y
   393                                  STA (@NEW),Y
   394                                  DEY
   395                                  BNE -
   396                                  ;; allocate a new pair (float * int)
   397                          @pair   LDA @NEW
   398                                  STA @FLO
   399                                  LDA @NEW + 1
   400                                  STA @FLO + 1                    ;save new float ptr in @FLO
   401                                  LDA # 0                         ;tag of new pair
   402                                  LDX # 2                         ;size of new pair
   403                                  JSR caml_alloc                  ;alloc new pair
   404                                  ;; set pair elements
   405                                  LDA @FLO
   406                                  STA (@NEW),Y
   407                                  INY
   408                                  LDA @FLO + 1
   409                                  STA (@NEW),Y                    ;field0 := new float
   410                                  INY
   411                                  LDX # 0
   412                                  PLA                             ;reload biased exponent
   413                                  BNE @debias                     ;exp = 0?
   414                                  LDA # <Val_zero                 ;yes: set field1,lo := <Val_int(0)
   415                                  STA (@NEW),Y
   416                                  LDA # >Val_zero
   417                                  BEQ @fld1h                      ;     beq=jmp to set field1,hi
   418                          @debias SEC                             ;no:  compute debiased exponent
   419                                  SBC # $80
   420                                  BCS @valint                     ;     if negative,
   421                                  DEX                             ;     set hi byte = $FF
   422                                  SEC
   423                          @valint ROL                             ;compute <Val_int(exponent)
   424                                  STA (@NEW),Y                    ;field1,lo := <Val_int(exponent)
   425                                  TXA
   426                                  ROL                             ;compute >Val_int(exponent)
   427                          @fld1h  INY
   428                                  STA (@NEW),Y                    ;field1,hi := >Val_int(exponent)
   429                                  LDA @NEW
   430                                  STA ACCU
   431                                  LDA @NEW + 1
   432                                  STA ACCU + 1                    ;ACCU := new pair
   433                                  LDY # 0
   434                                  RTS
   435                          }

   523                          caml_float_alloc_result
   524                                  ;; store result in a new allocated float
   525                                  LDA # Double_tag
   526                                  LDX # Double_wosize
   527                                  LDY # 0
   528                                  JSR caml_alloc
   529                                  LDX BLK
   530                                  LDY BLK + 1
   531                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_MOVMF
   532                                  LDA BLK

   540                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_float_loadFAC {
   541                                  ;; how to use:
   542                                  ;; 1) set  caml_float_loadFAC_addr
   543                                  ;; 2) call caml_float_loadFAC
   544                          caml_float_loadFAC
   545                                  LDX # 4
   546                          caml_float_loadFAC_addr = * + 1
   547                          -       LDA .dummy,X            ;SMC: replaced with real address
   548                                  STA C64_FAC,X
   549                                  DEX
   550                                  BPL -
   551                                  LDA C64_FAC + 1         ;copy 1st byte of mantissa
   552                                  STA C64_FAC + 5         ;to FAC sign byte
   553                                  ORA # $80
   554                                  STA C64_FAC + 1         ;set 1st bit of mantissa = 1
   555                                  INX
   556                                  STX C64_FACRND          ;FAC round byte := 0
   557                                  RTS
   558                          }
   559                          
   560                          !ifdef caml_PRIM__caml_float_loadARG {
   561                                  ;; how to use:
   562                                  ;; 1) set  caml_float_loadARG_addr
   563                                  ;; 2) call caml_float_loadARG
   564                          caml_float_loadARG
   565                                  LDX # 4
   566                          caml_float_loadARG_addr = * + 1
   567                          -       LDA .dummy,X            ;SMC: replaced with real address
   568                                  STA C64_ARG,X
   569                                  DEX
   570                                  BPL -
   571                                  LDX C64_ARG + 1         ;copy 1st byte of mantissa
   572                                  STX C64_ARG + 5         ;to ARG sign byte
   573                                  TXA
   574                                  EOR C64_FAC + 5         ;compare with FAC sign byte
   575                                  STA C64_ARISGN          ;store result of comparison
   576                                  TXA
   577                                  ORA # $80
   578                                  STA C64_ARG + 1         ;set 1st bit of mantissa = 1
   579                                  LDA C64_FAC             ;.A := FAC exponent
   580                                  RTS
   581                          }

    32                          !macro caml_int32_alloc {
    33                                  LDA # Custom_tag
    34                                  LDX # 3
    35                                  JSR caml_alloc
    36                          }
    37                          
    38                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_custom {
    39                          !align $01, $00
    40                          caml_int32_custom
    41                                  !word caml_int32_compare
    42                                  !word caml_int32_hash
    43                          caml_int32_compare
    44                                  STY TMP + 2
    45                                  LDA (SP),Y
    46                                  STA TMP
    47                                  INY
    48                                  LDA (SP),Y
    49                                  STA TMP + 1
    50                                  SEC
    51                                  LDX # 3
    52                          -       INY
    53                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
    54                                  SBC (TMP),Y
    55                                  ORA TMP + 2
    56                                  STA TMP + 2
    57                                  DEX
    58                                  BNE -
    59                                  INY
    60                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
    61                                  SBC (TMP),Y
    62                                  BVC +
    63                                  EOR # $80
    64                          +       BMI ++                          ;jump if <
    65                                  LDY # 0
    66                                  STY ACCU + 1
    67                                  ORA TMP + 2
    68                                  BNE +                           ;jump if >
    69                                  LDA # <Val_zero
    70                                  STA ACCU
    71                                  RTS
    72                          +       LDA # <Val_one
    73                                  STA ACCU
    74                                  RTS
    75                          ++      LDY # $FF
    76                                  STY ACCU
    77                                  STY ACCU + 1
    78                                  INY
    79                                  RTS
    80                          caml_int32_hash
    81                                  LDY # 5
    82                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
    83                                  DEY
    84                                  EOR (ACCU),Y
    85                                  TAX
    86                                  DEY
    87                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
    88                                  DEY
    89                                  EOR (ACCU),Y
    90                                  SEC
    91                                  ROL
    92                                  STA ACCU
    93                                  TXA
    94                                  ROL
    95                                  STA ACCU + 1
    96                                  LDY # 0
    97                                  RTS
    98                          }
    99                          
   100                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_neg {
   101                          caml_int32_neg
   102                                  +caml_int32_alloc
   103                                  LDX # 0
   104                                  SEC
   105                                  LDA # < caml_int32_custom
   106                                  STA (BLK),Y

   108                                  LDA # > caml_int32_custom
   109                                  STA (BLK),Y
   110                            !for @i, 1, 4 {
   111                                  INY

   114                                  STA (BLK),Y
   115                            }

   382                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_mul {
   383                          caml_int32_mul
   384                          @M      = TMP                                   ;4 bytes
   385                          @P      = TMP + 4                               ;4 bytes
   386                          @NPTR   = TMP + 8                               ;2 bytes
   387                                  +caml_int32_alloc
   388                                  SEC
   389                                  LDA (SP),Y
   390                                  SBC # $FF - 5                   :!warn "COS'E'? COMMENTARE!"
   391                                  STA @NPTR
   392                                  INY
   393                                  LDA (SP),Y
   394                                  SBC # 0
   395                                  STA @NPTR + 1
   396                                  LDX # 0
   397                                  LDY # 5
   398                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
   399                                  LSR
   400                                  STA @M + 3
   401                                  STX @P + 3
   402                            !for @i, 2, 0 {
   403                                  DEY
   404                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
   405                                  ROR
   406                                  STA @M + @i
   407                                  STX @P + @i
   408                            }
   409                          ;;      ldx #32
   410                          ;; --   bcc +
   411                          ;;      clc
   412                          ;;      ldy #$FF - 3
   413                          ;; -    lda (@NPTR),Y
   414                          ;;      adc @P - $FF + 3,Y
   415                          ;;      sta @P - $FF + 3,Y
   416                          ;;      iny
   417                          ;;      bne -
   418                          ;; +    lsr @P + 3
   419                          ;;  !for @i, 2, 0 {ror @P + @i}
   420                          ;;  !for @i, 3, 0 {ror @M + @i}
   421                          ;;      dex
   422                          ;;      bne --
   423                                  LDX # 8
   424                          --      BCC +
   425                                  CLC
   426                                  LDY # $FF-3
   427                          -       LDA (@NPTR),Y
   428                                  ADC @P - $FF + 3,Y
   429                                  STA @P - $FF + 3,Y
   430                                  INY
   431                                  BNE -
   432                          +       LSR @P + 3
   433                            !for @i, 2, 0 {
   434                                  ROR @P + @i
   435                            }
   436                            !for @i, 3, 0 {
   437                                  ROR @M + @i
   438                            }
   439                                  DEX
   440                                  BNE --
   441                                  LDA @NPTR
   442                                  BNE +
   443                                  DEC @NPTR + 1
   444                          +       DEC @NPTR
   445                                  LDX # 8
   446                          --      BCC +
   447                                  CLC
   448                                  LDY # $FF-2
   449                          -       LDA (@NPTR),Y
   450                                  ADC @P - $FF + 2,Y
   451                                  STA @P - $FF + 2,Y
   452                                  INY
   453                                  BNE -
   454                          +       LSR @P + 2
   455                            !for @i, 1, 0 {
   456                                  ROR @P + @i
   457                            }
   458                            !for @i, 3, 0 {
   459                                  ROR @M + @i
   460                            }
   461                                  DEX
   462                                  BNE --
   463                                  LDA @NPTR
   464                                  BNE +
   465                                  DEC @NPTR + 1
   466                          +       DEC @NPTR
   467                                  LDX # 8
   468                          --      BCC +
   469                                  CLC
   470                                  LDY # $FF - 1
   471                          -       LDA (@NPTR),Y
   472                                  ADC @P - $FF + 1,Y
   473                                  STA @P - $FF + 1,Y
   474                                  INY
   475                                  BNE -
   476                          +       LSR @P + 1
   477                                  ROR @P
   478                            !for @i, 3, 0 {
   479                                  ROR @M + @i
   480                            }
   481                                  DEX
   482                                  BNE --
   483                                  LDA @NPTR
   484                                  BNE +
   485                                  DEC @NPTR + 1
   486                          +       DEC @NPTR
   487                                  LDX # 8
   488                          --      BCC +
   489                                  CLC
   490                                  LDY # $FF
   491                                  LDA (@NPTR),Y
   492                                  ADC @P - $FF,Y
   493                                  STA @P - $FF,Y
   494                          +       LSR @P
   495                            !for @i, 3, 0 {
   496                                  ROR @M + @i
   497                            }
   498                                  DEX
   499                                  BNE --
   500                                  LDY # 5
   501                          -       LDA @M - 2,Y
   502                                  STA (BLK),Y
   503                                  DEY
   504                                  CPY # 2
   505                                  BCS -
   506                                  LDA BLK
   507                                  STA ACCU
   508                                  LDA BLK + 1
   509                                  STA ACCU + 1
   510                                  LDY # 0
   511                                  RTS
   512                          }

   514                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_of_float {
   515                          caml_int32_of_float

   519                                  LDA ACCU + 1

   538                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_to_float {
   539                          caml_int32_to_float
   540                                  STY C64_FAC + 5                 ;clear FAC sign
   541                                  STY C64_FACRND                  ;clear FAC round byte
   542                                  LDA # 32 + $80                  ;set exponent
   543                                  STA C64_FAC
   544                                  LDY # 2
   545                                  LDX # 3
   546                          -       LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;copy int32 into FAC mantissa
   547                                  STA C64_FAC + 1,X
   548                                  INY
   549                                  DEX
   550                                  BPL -
   551                                  EOR # $80
   552                                  CMP # $80                       ;set carry if int32 is positive
   553                                  +caml_JSR_BASROM C64_FADFLT     ;normalize
   554                                  JMP caml_float_alloc_result
   555                          }

   581                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_to_int {
   582                          caml_int32_to_int
   583                                  LDY # 2
   584                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
   585                                  SEC
   586                                  ROL
   587                                  TAX
   588                                  INY
   589                                  LDA (ACCU),Y
   590                                  ROL
   591                                  STA ACCU + 1
   592                                  STX ACCU
   593                                  LDY # 0
   594                                  RTS

   596                          
   597                          ;; Conversion from IEEE754 binary32 to C64FLP and vice-versa.
   598                          ;; See en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single-precision_floating-point_format
   599                          ;; &   www.c64-wiki.com/wiki/Floating_point_arithmetic
   600                          ;;
   601                          ;; IEEE754:      |±¦e07_e01|e00¦m22_m16|m15_m08|m07_m00|
   602                          ;; little-endian |m07_m00|m15_m08|e00¦m22_m16|±¦e07_e01| Int32.t
   603                          ;; exponent representation: excess-127
   604                          ;;      exp = $01...$FE -> ± (2^(exp-127) * 1.mantissa)
   605                          ;;      exp = $FF -> special numbers: NaN, +infinity, -infinity
   606                          ;;      exp = $00, mantissa =  0 -> +0.0, -0.0
   607                          ;;      exp = $00, mantissa <> 0 ->  ± (2^(-126) * 0.mantissa)
   608                          ;; range:   ±1.17549435E-38 ... ±3.40282346E+38 (normal)
   609                          ;;          ±1.40129846E-45 ... ±1.17549421E-38 (subnormal)
   610                          ;; example: 1.0= |0¦0111111|1¦0000000|00000000|00000000|
   611                          ;; little-endian |00000000|00000000|1¦0000000|0¦0111111| Int32.t
   612                          ;;
   613                          ;; C64 (in RAM): |E07_E00|±¦M30_M24|M23_M16|M15_M08|M07_M00|
   614                          ;; C64 (in FAC): |E07_E00|1¦M30_M24|M23_M16|M15_M08|M07_M00|±///////|
   615                          ;; exponent representation: excess-128
   616                          ;;      exp = $01...$FF -> ± (2^(exp-128) * 0.1mantissa)
   617                          ;;      exp = $00 -> 0.0
   618                          ;; range:   ±2.93873588E-39 ... ±1.70141183E+38
   619                          ;; example: 1.0= |10000001|0¦0000000|00000000|00000000|00000000|  (RAM)
   620                          ;;          1.0= |10000001|1¦0000000|00000000|00000000|00000000|0|(FAC)
   621                          
   622                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_bits_of_float {
   623                          caml_int32_bits_of_float
   624                                  +caml_int32_alloc
   625                                  LDA ACCU
   626                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr
   627                                  LDA ACCU + 1
   628                                  STA caml_float_loadFAC_addr + 1
   629                                  JSR caml_float_loadFAC
   630                                  LDY # 5                         ; (BLK),Y points to int32 last byte
   631                                  LDX C64_FAC                     ; load c64 exponent
   632                                  BEQ @exp0                       ; switch
   633                                  DEX
   634                                  BEQ @exp1
   635                                  DEX
   636                                  BEQ @exp2
   637                                  ;; c64 exponent > 2:
   638                                  ;; ieee_exp = c64_exp - 2, ieee_mant = asl c64_mant (drop leftmost 1)
   639                                  ;; normal representation - rounding may increment exponent by one
   640                                  CLC                             ;flag: .C=1 if called from @exp2
   641                          @round  BIT C64_FAC + 4                 ;round mantissa
   642                                  BPL +
   643                                  INC C64_FAC + 3
   644                                  BNE +
   645                                  INC C64_FAC + 2
   646                                  BNE +
   647                                  INC C64_FAC + 1
   648                                  BNE +
   649                                  INX                             ;increment exponent if needed
   650                          +       BCS @exp2r                      ;return if called from @exp2
   651                                  ASL C64_FAC + 1                 ;remove leftmost 1 from mantissa
   652                                  ASL C64_FAC + 5                 ;.C := sign bit
   653                                  TXA                             ;.A := exponent |e07_e00|
   654                                  ROR                             ;.A := |±¦e07_e01|, .C := e00
   655                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |±¦e07_e01|
   656                                  LDA C64_FAC + 1                 ;.A := |m22_m16¦0|
   657                                  ROR                             ;.A := |e00¦m22_m16|
   658                                  DEY
   659                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |e00¦m22_m16|
   660                                  LDA C64_FAC + 2                 ;.A := |m15_m08|
   661                                  DEY
   662                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |m15_m08|
   663                                  LDA C64_FAC + 3                 ;.A := |m07_m00|
   664                          @end    DEY
   665                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |m07_m00|
   666                                  LDY # 0
   667                                  LDA BLK
   668                                  STA ACCU
   669                                  LDA BLK + 1
   670                                  STA ACCU + 1
   671                                  ;ACCU := int32
   672                                  RTS                             ;return
   673                                  ;; c64_exp = 0: ieee_exp = 0, ieee_mant = 0
   674                          @exp0   TXA                             ;.A := 0
   675                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store zero into all bytes
   676                                  DEY
   677                                  STA (BLK),Y
   678                                  DEY
   679                                  STA (BLK),Y
   680                                  JMP @end                        ;...continue
   681                                  ;; c64_exp = 1: ieee_exp = 0, ieee_mant = lsr c64_mant (subnormal)
   682                                  ;; rounding doesn't affect exponent, as mantissa is 0.0mmm...
   683                          @exp1   LSR C64_FAC + 1                 ;lsr mantissa
   684                                  ROR C64_FAC + 2
   685                                  ROR C64_FAC + 3
   686                                  ROR C64_FAC + 4                 ;fallthrough @exp2
   687                                  ;; c64_exp = 2: ieee_exp = 0, ieee_mant = c64_mant (subnormal)
   688                                  ;; rounding may incr. exponent and cause a switch from
   689                                  ;; subnormal repr. (2^(-126) * 0.mantissa, 0 implicit)
   690                                  ;; to normal one (2^(-126) * 1.rnd_mantissa, 1 implicit)
   691                          @exp2   SEC                             ;use .C as a return flag
   692                                  BCS @round                      ;round mantissa
   693                          @exp2r  TXA                             ;.A := exponent |e07_e00|
   694                                  ASL C64_FAC + 5                 ;.C := sign bit
   695                                  ROR                             ;.A := |±¦e07_e01|, .C := e00
   696                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |±¦e07_e01|
   697                                  LDA C64_FAC + 1
   698                                  ROR
   699                                  DEY
   700                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |e00¦m22_m16|
   701                                  LDA C64_FAC + 2
   702                                  ROR
   703                                  DEY
   704                                  STA (BLK),Y                     ;store |m15_m08|
   705                                  LDA C64_FAC + 3
   706                                  ROR
   707                                  JMP @end                        ;...continue
   708                          }
   709                          
   710                          !ifdef  caml_PRIM__caml_int32_float_of_bits {
   711                          caml_int32_float_of_bits
   712                                  LDY # 4
   713                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;.A <- e00¦m22_m16
   714                                  CMP # $80                       ;.C <- e00
   715                                  ORA # $80                       ;.A <- 1¦m22_m16
   716                                  STA C64_FAC + 1                 ;store into FAC
   717                                  INY
   718                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;.A <- sign¦e07_e01
   719                                  ROL                             ;.C <- sign, .A <- e07_e00
   720                                  ROR C64_FAC + 5                 ;put sign into FAC sign byte
   721                                  CMP # $FE                       ;raise exn if NaN, +-infinity, or
   722                                  BCS @exn                        ;if conversion would overflow
   723                                  TAX                             ;.X <- exp
   724                                  LDY # 3
   725                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;.A <- m15_m08
   726                                  STA C64_FAC + 2                 ;store into FAC
   727                                  DEY
   728                                  LDA (ACCU),Y                    ;.A <- m07_m00
   729                                  STA C64_FAC + 3                 ;store into FAC
   730                                  LDY # 0
   731                                  STY C64_FAC + 4                 ;clear FAC unused mantissa bits
   732                                  STY C64_FACRND                  ;and FAC round byte
   733                                  CPX # 1
   734                                  BCC @zero                       ;jump if +0.0, -0.0 or subnormal
   735                                  INX
   736                                  INX                             ;adjust exp bias
   737                          -       STX C64_FAC                     ;set FAC exp
   738                                  JMP caml_float_alloc_result     ;allocate float and return
   739                          @zero   LDA C64_FAC + 3                 ;check if +0.0 or -0.0
   740                                  BNE @subnrm                     ;jump if subnormal
   741                                  LDA C64_FAC + 2
   742                                  BNE @subnrm                     ;jump if subnormal
   743                                  LDA C64_FAC + 1
   744                                  AND # $7F                       ;ignore leftmost bit of mantissa (1)
   745                                  BNE @subnrm                     ;jump if subnormal
   746                                  STA C64_FAC + 1
   747                                  STA C64_FAC + 5                 ;clear minus sign, if any
   748                                  BEQ -                           ;set FAC exp, allocate float and return
   749                          @subnrm LDX # 2                         ;subnormal: set biased exp = -126
   750                                  STX C64_FAC
   751                          -       ASL C64_FAC + 3                 ;try to normalize (FAC+4 ignored as null)
   752                                  ROL C64_FAC + 2
   753                                  ROL C64_FAC + 1
   754                                  BMI +                           ;ok, leftmost bit is 1
   755                                  DEC C64_FAC
   756                                  BNE -
   757                                  LDY # 0                         ;ko, result is zero
   758                                  STY C64_FAC + 5                 ;clear minus sign, if any
   759                          +       JMP caml_float_alloc_result     ;allocate float and return
   760                          @exn    +caml_raise Invalid_argument, "Int32.float_of_bits"
   761                          }
   762

   764                          ; caml_int32_mod(value v1, value v2)
   765                          ; caml_int32_bswap(value v)
   766                          
   767                          }	;; zone caml_INT32

    38                          !macro caml_int64_alloc {
    39                                  LDA # Custom_tag
    40                                  LDX # 5
    41                                  JSR caml_alloc
